formulas.ledger: Domain overall = crawl score from aggregated page runs. Category rows = lens scores over the corpus.
formulas.corpus: Pages scanned · issue groups · total runner errors across all single-page scans in the deep scan.
formulas.performance: Averages of lab timings (TTFB / FCP / LCP / DOM) across measured pages — not one URL.
formulas.seo: Coverage = share of pages with title / H1 / meta / canonical. Conflicts = mismatch & duplicate group counts.
formulas.ux: Corpus UX score + readability band counts + pages with skipped headings / multiple H1.
formulas.eco: Avg CO₂ and page weight; grade distribution across the crawl.
formulas.links: Sum of internal / external / broken links discovered across pages.
formulas.shield: Corpus security & privacy flags (CSP share, cookie banner, privacy policy presence).
formulas.eeat: E-E-A-T page counts: contact / privacy / impressum / about / team / citations.
formulas.geo: Domain GEO = 0.52 × avg discoverability + 0.48 × avg repurposing across pages.
formulas.infra: Hosting / CDN / platform inventory sampled from the crawl.
formulas.class: Theme rollup and tag intensity from page classification.
formulas.samples: Weakest page samples from the crawl (teaser — not full slim table).
